description: Real-Time Road Conditions is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Austin Transportation & Public Works maintains road condition sensors across the city which monitor the temperature and surface condition of roadways. These sensors enable our Mobility Management Center to stay apprised of potential roadway freezing events and intervene when necessary. This data is updated continuously every 5 minutes. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. The table has 32 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
